title: Rare-find Glimmer
notes: Night Market: the Glimmer history now shows today's rare-find Glimmer and the daily cap (now 10,000).

title: Ranked is now Live 3v3
notes: Classic auto Ranked has ended and its season rewards were sent. Ranked is now Live 3v3, with the Open League and the Lv 50 League.

title: Live 3v3
notes: Live 3v3: real-time ranked battles against other trainers. Bring 3 Pokémon, both trainers pick a move each turn, then you watch it play out together.
Two leagues, each with its own rating, leaderboard and rewards: the Open League, where your Pokémon fight at their own level, and the Lv 50 League, where everyone fights at Lv 50.
Find it on the Friends tab: pick a league, choose your 3 and press Find a match. You can also challenge a friend.
Season 1 runs for 4 weeks and ends on a Sunday at 18:00 UTC. The Season rewards panel shows the countdown and your rank.

The top 3 of the Lv 50 League win an Event Glitched Victini: Prismatic for 1st, Void for 2nd, Shiny for 3rd. The top 3 of the Open League win an Event Glitched Charizard in the same looks. More rewards all the way down both ladders.

Battle Tower: damage that takes a share of max HP (poison, Toxic, burn, Leech Seed, Curse and similar) now gets weaker as the floor's stat boost grows, and a boss's Struggle recoil now counts against one HP bar instead of the whole boss. Climb runs started before this update can't post to the leaderboard.
